values: Please provide procurement history for all available crops and locations. Five years is preferred. Inventory history is optional and should only be supplied when it comes from reliable daily snapshots or a dated movement ledger.
One crop/product line within one procurement order
One end-of-day stock snapshot for one crop and location
One dated stock-in, stock-out, opening-balance or adjustment event
One truck assigned to an outlet or hub
Do not include Stock Available repeated on procurement/order rows. Repeated balances can substantially overstate monthly supply.
Leave missing values blank. Enter zero only when the true measured value is zero.
Use one consistent crop name and location name across all sheets.
Use real Excel dates/datetimes. ISO format YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM is preferred.
Price must be the actual procurement/farm-gate price paid per stated price unit, not the total order value.
Requested Quantity records demand. Fulfilled Quantity records the amount actually supplied and must be between zero and the requested quantity.
For inventory, provide either reliable daily snapshots or a complete movement ledger with opening balances. Both are welcome but neither should be reconstructed from repeated order-level values.
Include all available crops and locations. Keep cancelled and partially fulfilled orders and identify them using Order Status.
Unique line identifier when an order contains multiple crops
Quantity actually supplied; 0 to Requested Quantity
Unit used for requested and fulfilled quantity
Operational reporting only; not required by the forecasting models
Actual procurement/farm-gate price per Price Unit
Currency and quantity basis for Price
Date of the end-of-day inventory balance
End-of-day quantity available for new orders
Opening Balance, Stock In, Stock Out, Adjustment
Non-negative movement quantity; Movement Type provides direction
Source transaction, receipt, delivery or adjustment ID
Expected journey time under normal conditions
